note: The studios' hand table (scripts/build_studios.py): what Wikidata does not link, each entry with its sources and, where a sentence is quoted, the sentence exactly as its source gives it. 'drop' removes a statement of Wikidata's that is plainly a mis-linked item, with the reason. Coordinates of a street address are OpenStreetMap's (Nominatim), geocoded from the address the source gives.

said.q: Cézanne's studio is a biographical museum about the painter Paul Cézanne, in Aix-en-Provence in Southern France. It was his studio from 1902 until his death in 1906.

studios.name: The Factory, 231 East 47th Street
studios.why: a historic studio: the building is gone

said.q: In November 1963, Warhol found another loft on the fifth floor at 231 East 47th Street in Midtown Manhattan, which would become the first Factory.
The location where 231 East 47th Street once was is now the entrance to the parking garage of One Dag.

studios.name: The Factory, Decker Building, 33 Union Square West
studios.why: a historic studio: the artist died in 1987

said.q: In February 1968, Warhol relocated the Factory to the Decker Building at 33 Union Square West.

studios.name: The Factory, 860 Broadway
studios.why: a historic studio: the artist died in 1987

said.q: In August 1974, Warhol relocated the Factory to 860 Broadway, a former 19th-century warehouse overlooking Union Square Park at East 17th Street and Broadway in Manhattan.

studios.name: The Factory, 158 Madison Avenue
studios.why: a historic studio: the artist died in 1987

said.q: After renovations, Warhol relocated his studio there at the end of 1984.

studios.name: New York
studios.why: the record names the town only

said.q: From 1955 to 1959, he worked in New York, where he became a prominent figure among a group of artists including Robert Rauschenberg, with whom he was sharing a studio, and Jasper Johns.

studios.name: Rome
studios.why: a home: its address is private

said.q: In 1957, Twombly moved to Rome and made it his primary city, where he met the Italian artist Tatiana Franchetti – sister of his patron Baron Giorgio Franchetti.
Twombly bought a house and rented a studio in Gaeta in the early 1990s.
He built a studio nearby and lived in the house for the remainder of his life.
